## Summary

Describe the user or maintainer outcome in one or two short paragraphs.

## What Changed

- List the shipped behavior in complete, specific bullets.
- Explain the cause when this is a fix.
- State important safeguards and unchanged behavior.

## Validation

- List the completed compile and static checks.
- Summarize the relevant local verification.
- State any validation that was not performed.

## Data and Privacy

Describe any effect on network access, local storage, provider data, report
provenance, or accuracy claims.

## Documentation and Release Impact

List updated documentation and whether release notes are needed.

## Known Limitations

List any unresolved or intentionally unsupported behavior.
